Class SemanticCaptureMapping

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.capture.generate.SemanticCaptureMapping
public final class SemanticCaptureMapping extends Object
Single-source bridge between capture LocatorCandidate.LocatorStrategy / LocatorPolicy.Tier and engine SemanticLocatorStrategy (issue #5819 / #5457).

Intentional difference: codegen emission vs runtime resolve

  • Runtime / agent / heal (FR-1): SemanticLocatorStrategy order — ROLE → ACCESSIBLE_NAME → LABEL → TEXT → TEST_ID → ID → NAME → CSS → XPATH.
  • Capture codegen emission: LocatorPolicy.Tier elevates a unique, stable, human-authored id (LocatorPolicy.Tier.UNIQUE_ID) above a verified ARIA role for generated source stability. That is not a second FR-1; within a tier, LocatorRanker still scores strategies via SemanticLocatorStrategy.rankPriority().
